articles.title: In Jabalpur: Spa Operator Kidnapped, Beaten With Belts and Rope in Hotel Room
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 23-year-old spa operator was allegedly kidnapped, held captive overnight and brutally assaulted inside a hotel room in Madhya Pradesh's Jabalpur, police said.

body.html:
A 23-year-old spa operator was allegedly kidnapped, held captive overnight and brutally assaulted inside a hotel room in Madhya Pradesh's Jabalpur, police said.

A video of the assault has gone viral on social media, showing the victim, identified as Abhishek Thakur, crying in pain and pleading for help while being repeatedly beaten with a belt and a thick rope.

According to police, the incident took place on Wednesday evening. Abhishek was allegedly called to Yadav Colony by hotel operator Pradeep Panda. When he arrived, he was allegedly abducted at knifepoint and taken to a hotel near the Zero Degree area in Vijay Nagar.

Police said Abhishek had an old financial dispute with hotel operator Sahil Chaudhary, and the two had reportedly argued over money matters in the past.

As per the complaint, Abhishek was taken to a hotel room where Sahil Chaudhary and his associates allegedly assaulted him with belts and ropes. The attack was reportedly recorded on video, which later surfaced online.

The victim's friends told police that after the assault in the hotel room, the accused forced him into a car and allegedly continued beating him while driving around the city.

Police further said Abhishek was kept in their custody throughout the night. The accused allegedly forced him to transfer ₹80,000 online and also took ₹15,000 in cash before releasing him.

The victim's family claimed he left for Bhopal after the incident out of fear and switched off his mobile phone. They also alleged that they received death threats, which is why they did not immediately approach the police.

Investigators said Abhishek had earlier worked with Sahil Chaudhary but had started his own business a few months ago. Police suspect the assault may be linked to an old business dispute.

Additional Superintendent of Police Anjana Tiwari said the viral video is around two days old.

The investigation has been handed over to the Lordganj police station, and teams have been formed to trace the accused. Police said further action will be taken after recording statements and completing the investigation.

articles.title: Morning Walk Turns Horrific! Speeding Car Mows Down Two Elderly Sisters in Mathura
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two elderly sisters were seriously injured after being hit by a speeding car while out for a morning walk in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media. The accident took place on Sunday in the Barsana police station area.

body.html:
Two elderly sisters were seriously injured after being hit by a speeding car while out for a morning walk in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media.

The accident took place on Sunday in the Barsana police station area. The victims, Sumitra Devi (60) and her elder sister Lakshmi Devi (65), residents of Katara Mohalla in Barsana, were walking near the bus stand when a speeding Swift car allegedly hit them from behind and fled the scene.

The impact threw both women several feet into the air. Sumitra Devi suffered three fractures in her leg, while both sisters sustained serious injuries to their heads, arms, legs and eyes. They were rushed to a private hospital for treatment.

The 7-second CCTV clip, which surfaced on Tuesday evening, shows the car striking the sisters from behind before speeding away.

Following the emergence of the footage, police traced the vehicle's registration number as HR 50 K 2159. Based on a complaint filed by Sumitra Devi's son, Sanjay, an FIR has been registered against the unidentified driver.

Police said efforts are underway to trace the car and identify the driver. Further investigation is in progress.

#Mathura #UttarPradesh #RoadAccident #HitAndRun #ViralVideo

articles.title: CCTV Captures Horrific LPG Tanker Blast at Kaushambi Toll Plaza That Killed Five
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: CCTV footage has surfaced showing the devastating LPG tanker crash and explosion at the Sirohi Toll Plaza in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district that claimed five lives.

body.html:
CCTV footage has surfaced showing the devastating LPG tanker crash and explosion at the Sirohi Toll Plaza in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district that claimed five lives.

The accident occurred at around 6:38 am on June 26 under the Kokhraj police station limits when an LPG tanker travelling from Kanpur to Pratapgarh rammed into the toll barrier. The impact caused a massive gas leak, which spread across the toll plaza within seconds.

The footage shows the gas engulfing the entire toll plaza while toll workers and motorists rushed to escape. Around three minutes later, the leaked gas reached a generator running inside the toll plaza building, triggering a massive explosion and fire that engulfed the entire complex.

The blaze destroyed the toll plaza along with 16 motorcycles and two cars parked nearby.

Five people, including tanker driver Dharmendra Dubey, lost their lives in the incident. Dubey was burnt alive inside the tanker, while toll employees Alok Singh, Anil Kumar, Hiramani Singh and Krishnapal Maurya later succumbed to their injuries. Another injured person is undergoing treatment in Prayagraj.

As the fire destroyed the toll plaza's CCTV system, experts later recovered the footage from the server. Police are investigating the exact cause of the crash.

articles.title: Caught on Camera! Speeding Scorpio Chases Down Man in Deadly Faridabad Clash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute between two groups turned fatal in Haryana's Faridabad after a man was allegedly chased and run over by a speeding Scorpio SUV. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A dispute between two groups turned fatal in Haryana's Faridabad after a man was allegedly chased and run over by a speeding Scorpio SUV. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

The 17-second footage shows a group of men, including the victim, running before the Scorpio enters the frame, appears to target the victim and rams into him before crashing into a brick wall.

Faridabad Police have registered two FIRs based on complaints filed by both groups. Officials said seven people from the two sides have been named in the cases.

Police are examining the viral video, CCTV footage and other evidence to establish the sequence of events and identify those responsible.

Further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

articles.title: Open Manhole Claims Life! 60-Year-Old Pedestrian Swept Away During Drainage Work in Mumbai
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 60-year-old man died after falling into an open manhole during drainage maintenance work in Mumbai's Sakinaka area on Wednesday.

body.html:
A 60-year-old man died after falling into an open manhole during drainage maintenance work in Mumbai's Sakinaka area on Wednesday.

The deceased, identified as Aslam Isak Shaikh, a resident of Yadav Nagar, allegedly fell into the uncovered manhole on Khairani Road while walking and talking on his mobile phone.

According to police, private contractual workers had removed the manhole cover to carry out repairs on a drainage grill near Sanman Hotel and S J Studio. After Shaikh fell into the drain, workers attempted to rescue him by lowering a ladder but recovered only his umbrella and slippers. The strong water flow swept him away.

The Mumbai Fire Brigade launched a search operation and recovered Shaikh's body from the drainage channel after several hours.

Police have launched an investigation to determine whether adequate safety measures, including barricades and warning signs, were in place at the work site.

Following the incident, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) announced action against the contractor responsible for the work and suspended four officials pending an inquiry over alleged negligence.

#Mumbai #Sakinaka #Accident #Monsoon #MumbaiNews

articles.title: Hidden Pothole Turns Dangerous Trap! CCTV Captures Biker Crashing Into Water-Filled Pit in Junagadh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A motorcyclist sustained serious injuries after falling into a waterlogged pothole on a poorly repaired road at Azad Chowk in Gujarat's Junagadh city. The accident was captured on CCTV. The footage shows the biker losing control after riding into a deep pothole concealed by rainwater.

body.html:
A motorcyclist sustained serious injuries after falling into a waterlogged pothole on a poorly repaired road at Azad Chowk in Gujarat's Junagadh city. The accident was captured on CCTV.

The footage shows the biker losing control after riding into a deep pothole concealed by rainwater. He suffered a serious head injury and was rushed to a hospital for treatment. The woman travelling with him immediately rushed to his aid.

According to local residents, the road had been dug up for civic work but was never properly restored, leaving behind a deep crater that became invisible after being filled with rainwater.

In a separate incident, three to four people reportedly fell into the same waterlogged pothole in the Oghadnagar area, highlighting the poor condition of the city's roads. Fortunately, no serious injuries were reported in those incidents.

Heavy rainfall also caused severe waterlogging near the Joshipara drain at Majewadi Gate, where a car became stranded in floodwater. The Fire Brigade rescued the driver and safely recovered the vehicle.

The incidents have raised fresh concerns over Junagadh's road infrastructure and civic maintenance, with residents demanding immediate repairs and better safety measures to prevent further accidents.

#Junagadh #Gujarat #RoadSafety #ViralVideo #Monsoon #Potholes #BreakingNews

articles.title: Asked for 1 Kg Sweets, Allegedly Got Beaten Instead! Viral Video Sparks Outrage in Meerut
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A customer was allegedly assaulted at a sweet shop in Meerut's Ganganagar area after questioning why he was given less than one kilogram of sweets. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A customer was allegedly assaulted at a sweet shop in Meerut's Ganganagar area after questioning why he was given less than one kilogram of sweets. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to the complaint, Prince Rana, a resident of Dhanpur village, had visited a sweet shop in Kasheru Buxar with his maternal cousin on Thursday to purchase sweets priced at ₹350 per kg. He alleged that the shop handed over only around 800 grams instead of the one kilogram purchased.

When Prince objected and demanded the full quantity, an argument allegedly broke out. The dispute soon escalated, and the shop owner along with a few others allegedly assaulted Prince and his cousin.

Prince's cousin sustained a serious head injury during the incident. The assault was recorded by a bystander, and the video is now circulating widely on social media.

Based on Prince Rana's complaint, Ganganagar Police have launched an investigation. Police said appropriate legal action will be taken after the inquiry is completed.

#Meerut #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #Assault #BreakingNews

articles.title: Engineering Student Stabbed at Home After Allegedly Slapping Harassers in Karnataka
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A first-year engineering student was seriously injured after a group of people allegedly barged into her house and attacked her with sharp weapons in Chintamani town of Karnataka's Chikkaballapura district. The victim, S.

body.html:
A first-year engineering student was seriously injured after a group of people allegedly barged into her house and attacked her with sharp weapons in Chintamani town of Karnataka's Chikkaballapura district.

The victim, S. Meghana, is a first-year BE student and also works as a dance instructor for children at a local school.

According to the police complaint, the incident was triggered by an earlier confrontation at around 4:30 pm when Meghana alleged that two youths, identified as Karthik and Vinod, intercepted her, teased her and made inappropriate remarks while she was walking towards her two-wheeler. Meghana allegedly slapped the two men before leaving and informing her family about the incident.

Police said that at around 8:30 pm, Karthik, Vinod, Shalini, Kavya and several others allegedly arrived at Meghana's residence in Ashraya Layout, forcibly entered the house and attacked her in the presence of her family members.

According to the complaint, the accused allegedly threatened Meghana before attacking her with blades and other sharp weapons. She sustained serious injuries, including a stab injury to her abdomen, while her family members also alleged that she was assaulted and threatened with death.

The injured student was rushed to a nearby hospital before being shifted to a higher medical centre for specialised treatment. Doctors are continuing to monitor her condition.

Chintamani Town Police have registered a case against the named accused and several others. Investigators are also examining mobile phone videos, witness statements and medical evidence as part of the probe.

Police said efforts are underway to trace the remaining accused, and further legal action will be taken based on the investigation.

#Karnataka #Chikkaballapura #Chintamani #CrimeNews

articles.title: My Only Son Was Left to Die': Grieving Father Seeks Justice in Delhi Hit-and-Run Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The parents of 33-year-old Sarthak Mattoo, who was killed in a hit-and-run in South Delhi, have released an emotional video appealing for justice, alleging that the accused are roaming free while the family continues to grieve.

body.html:
The parents of 33-year-old Sarthak Mattoo, who was killed in a hit-and-run in South Delhi, have released an emotional video appealing for justice, alleging that the accused are roaming free while the family continues to grieve.

Sarthak was fatally hit by a speeding Thar on June 25 while riding his motorcycle to work near Vasant Kunj. The SUV allegedly fled the scene, leaving him critically injured on the road. He was later taken to the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre, where doctors declared him dead.

During the investigation, police traced the Thar to a Bengaluru-based private company. The vehicle had been leased to Sagar Saha (29), who allegedly told investigators that his friend, Apurv Singh (30), was driving the SUV at the time of the accident.

Delhi Police said Apurv Singh has been arrested and a case has been registered under Section 106(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). He has been granted bail, while the report of the alcohol test is still awaited.

In the video, Sarthak's father, Surender, alleged that blood samples of the accused were collected nearly 50 hours after the incident and questioned how alcohol could be detected after such a delay. He appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta and the Delhi Police Commissioner to ensure justice for his son.

The grieving father said he was prepared to do whatever it takes, including selling his house and his wife's jewellery, to pursue the case. His wife also alleged that justice was only available to the wealthy and expressed despair over the family's situation.

Police said further investigation is underway.

#Delhi #HitAndRun #JusticeForSarthak #RoadAccident #DelhiPolice

articles.title: Creche Staff Booked for Allegedly Assaulting and Terrorising Toddlers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Bengaluru City Police have registered a criminal case against five daycare workers at an on-campus creche operated at Capgemini Technology Services India Limited's Brookfield campus after allegations that toddlers were subjected to physical assault, intimidation and cruelty.

body.html:
The Bengaluru City Police have registered a criminal case against five daycare workers at an on-campus creche operated at Capgemini Technology Services India Limited's Brookfield campus after allegations that toddlers were subjected to physical assault, intimidation and cruelty.

The FIR was registered on June 29 at HAL Police Station based on a complaint filed by Tilakesh Kumar, a legal-cum-probation officer with the District Child Protection Unit, under charges of criminal intimidation and cruelty to children.

The accused have been identified as caregivers Manjula, Vijayalakshmi, Bhavani, Sindhu and Bindu.

According to the complaint, videos received via WhatsApp allegedly showed children crying and being subjected to abuse. The complaint alleges that the caregivers physically assaulted and mentally harassed the children by locking crying toddlers inside washing machines to frighten them, forcing them into narrow water-filled pipes, confining them in bathroom spaces and intimidating them in other ways.

Police said the children belonged to Capgemini employees who left them at the daycare while at work.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (Whitefield Division) Saidulu Adavath confirmed that a case has been registered and said notices would be issued to the accused, who will be summoned for questioning.

Following the incident, Capgemini announced the temporary closure of its Bengaluru on-campus daycare facility. In a statement, the company said it is cooperating fully with the authorities and has shut the facility as a precautionary measure while the investigation is underway.
